question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech. He will say that he is okay.

options.text: He will say, “I am always okay.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He will say that he is okay.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"he is okay" becomes "I am okay"**
 
 
• Pronoun "he" is changed to "I" to match direct speech.
 
• Since the reporting verb (He will say) is in future tense the reported speech (he is okay) will have no change in its tense form only verb "is" is changed to "am" to match the present tense in direct speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "I" and ends with a period "."
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
